_comment: Export presets: a format (see ProjectController::exportFormats) and a size, by its short side (keeping the canvas's shape) or exactly (filled and cropped). Missing values keep the dialog's defaults.

presets.title: 1080p for the web
presets.description: H.264 MP4, 1080 high: plays everywhere (YouTube, Vimeo, most sites)

presets.title: 4K for the web
presets.description: HEVC MP4, 2160 high: smaller files at full detail

presets.title: Small file
presets.description: H.264 MP4, 720 high, low bitrate: quick to send

presets.title: Vertical 9:16
presets.description: 1080 × 1920 H.264, filled: for short-video apps (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

presets.title: Master (ProRes 422 HQ)
presets.description: ProRes 422 HQ MOV with 24-bit sound at the project's size: for archiving and other editors

presets.title: Editing copy (ProRes Proxy)
presets.description: ProRes Proxy MOV, 540 high: light to edit with

presets.title: Animated GIF
presets.description: 360 high at 15 fps, looping, no sound

presets.title: Sound: FLAC
presets.description: 24-bit FLAC: the mix, lossless and smaller
